title: Prediction of Major Complications and Readmission After Lumbar Spinal Fusion: A Machine Learning-Driven Approach.
summary: 38,788 California lumbar-fusion patients (2015–2017), 80/20 holdout and cross-validation; XGBoost predicts 30-day major complications/readmission and identifies predictors, with AUROC/calibration comparison. Retrospective registry result, bounded to source population.
